# PDF.js runtime

OB Drawing vendors the Mozilla PDF.js generic runtime so the prototype does not require a runtime CDN connection.

- Version: `6.3.289`
- Source: <https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/tag/v6.3.289>
- Included: `pdf.mjs`, `pdf.worker.mjs`, packed CMaps, standard fonts, and `LICENSE.pdfjs`
- Excluded: full viewer UI, source maps, sandbox, and test PDF

Do not edit these runtime files manually. Replace them from one official stable distribution and update this note when upgrading.
